title: The cosine ceiling: code and summary results
description: Code, theory notes, summary results and manuscript sources for the Letter "The cosine ceiling: what random-projection Kenyon-cell codes can add to frozen embeddings". Contains the k-WTA Kenyon-cell code, the synthetic check of Observation 1, the closed-form overlap kappa(c) versus Monte-Carlo, the rotation control and the AUC comparison with the cosine and likelihood-ratio ceilings on CelebA face embeddings (facenet/VGGFace2 and DINOv2 ViT-S/14). CelebA images, identity labels, per-image splits and per-image embeddings are not redistributed; a seeded script rebuilds the splits from the original CelebA files. Code: MIT License.
